address: Municipal Building, Dale St, Liverpool, L2 2DH
bio: The Municipal Hotel is located on Dale Street, one of the original seven streets that make up the city centre as we know it today. The hotel is a perfect base to explore the city including its many cultural attractions, shops, bars & restaurants.  The beautifully designed Botanic Tearoom offers guests a truly divine experience with a Liverpool twist including Afternoon Tea. With a truly unique cocktail afternoon tea menu, based around Liverpool. Their expert hosts will guide you around your experience & hotel history before you are be met by one of our Tea Sommeliers. Afternoon Tea will be served in a elegant three course style, including scones, sandwiches, hot items & desserts.  Afternoon Tea is priced from £33 per person Monday - Thursday and from £39 per person Friday - Sunday.
